prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is his name.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O Todo-Poderoso fez grandes coisas por mim, e santo é o seu nome.

meta.face: Starting from the original painted face, keeping its head angle and lowered gaze: hair turned light auburn; a very short auburn beard; face made younger, around 27.
meta.basis: Young man with curly hair and a short beard (Painter's Manual); colouring and gaze chosen to separate him from Joseph and Mark.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Kept at first as matching the tradition; edited because it still matched Joseph and Mark
Second face came out too realistic for the card's painted style; redone as minimal trait changes on the original face
Raising the head to look forward read as looking at the camera; redone keeping the original lowered gaze
